definitions.explanation: Either of the front legs or paws of a four-legged animal or insect, as opposed to the hind legs. Also written {前脚|まえあし}.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}が{前足|まえあし}を{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The dog raised its front paw.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}は{前足|まえあし}で{顔|かお}を{洗|あら}う。
examples.english: Cats wash their faces with their front paws.

examples.japanese: カマキリは{前足|まえあし}を{使|つか}って{獲物|えもの}を{捕|つか}まえる。
examples.english: A praying mantis uses its forelegs to catch its prey.

notes:
The front leg or paw of an animal or insect. When emphasizing the paw or the limb's structure, the spelling {前脚|まえあし} is also used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前足|まえあし}を{上|あ}げる: to raise a front paw
- {前足|まえあし}で{立|た}つ: to stand on the front legs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後|うし}ろ{足|あし}: hind leg — the back leg of the same animal
